tasks.title: Hover time of a heavy vehicle
tasks.statement: A **{c} Ah** pack, hover current **{i} A**, using 80% of the capacity. What is the hover time (min)?
tasks.solution: t = 0.8·C / I · 60. For the course platform: 20 Ah, 30 A → ~32 min; the real time is shorter with maneuvers, wind, and cold.

tasks.title: Thrust per motor after a failure
tasks.statement: An X8 with a mass of **{m} kg** has lost one motor. What is the average thrust on each of the remaining motors (g) in hover?
tasks.solution: The weight is shared by 7 motors instead of 8. In practice the coaxial partner of the failed motor carries more than the average, so check in the log that its output is not hitting the maximum.
